name: read
description: 读取文件内容，支持文本/图片/PDF/Jupyter notebook/Office 及文档格式（docx/docm/dotx/doc、xlsx/xlsm/xltx/xltm/xls、pptx/pptm/potx/ppsx、odt/ods/odp/rtf；旧版 .ppt 不支持）。Word 提取纯文本（旧版含脚注/页眉页脚），Excel 转 CSV 分表展示，PPT/ODF/RTF 提取文本。支持全量读取（带行号）、精确行范围读取（offset+limit）、indentation 模式（基于缩进提取完整代码块）。支持多文件批量读取。自动检测 UTF-8/GBK 编码，检测 minified 文件。大于 50MB 的文件返回错误并提示。
description_en: Read file contents. Supports text/images/PDF/Jupyter notebooks/Office and document formats (docx/docm/dotx/doc, xlsx/xlsm/xltx/xltm/xls, pptx/pptm/potx/ppsx, odt/ods/odp/rtf; legacy .ppt is not supported). Word extracts plain text (legacy format includes footnotes/headers/footers), Excel is converted to CSV per sheet, PPT/ODF/RTF extract text. Supports full read (with line numbers), exact line-range read (offset+limit), and indentation mode (extract a complete code block based on indentation). Supports batch reading of multiple files. Auto-detects UTF-8/GBK encodings and minified files. Files larger than 50MB return an error with a hint.

path.description: 单个文件路径（与 paths 互斥）
path.description_en: Single file path (mutually exclusive with paths)

paths.description: 多文件批量读取路径数组（与 path 互斥）
paths.description_en: Array of paths for batch reading of multiple files (mutually exclusive with path)

offset.description: 精确模式：开始行号（1-based）；indentation 模式：锚点行号
offset.description_en: Precise mode: starting line number (1-based); indentation mode: anchor line number

limit.description_en: Precise mode: number of lines to read

mode.description: 读取模式：full=全量带行号（默认），precise=offset+limit 精确范围，indentation=基于缩进提取完整代码块
mode.description_en: Read mode: full=entire file with line numbers (default), precise=exact range via offset+limit, indentation=extract a complete code block based on indentation

pages.description: PDF 页码范围，如 '1-5' 或 '3'
